firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently planted a tree receives the First Player card and deals four cards to each player.
clarifications: Players resolve actions starting with the First Player card holder and then clockwise.
At round end, each player takes the unused cards from the player on their right, including the First Player card if present; the card's new holder leads the next round.
In the separate game against Hal variant, the human player is always first.

internalEvidence: Visually checked Pearl Games English rulebook PDF pages 2, 3, and 5; text on page 6 confirms the Hal variant exception. The setup instruction requires having planted a tree, not merely visited one. The First Player card travels with unused cards to the right-hand neighbor after a round.
